༄༅/ /rten rdzas dang snyan dar phul ba'i smon tshig dang 'dod gsol bcas bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// rten rdzas dang snyan dar phul ba'i smon tshig dang 'dod gsol bcas bzhugs so//

thog mar rje btsun dam pa chos rgyal phun tshogs bkra shis dpal bzang po'i dngul gdung la rgyal mtshan phul ba'i tshigs bcad smon lam ni/ dus gsum sangs rgyas gcig bsdus pa// rgyal ba'i bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal// 'gro mgon ras chen de nyid kyi// dngul gdung rin chen 'di dag la// lha rdzas rin chen 'di phul bas// sangs rgyas bstan pa dar ba dang*// dge 'dun 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang*// dam chos yun ring gnas pa'i phyir// 'dud cing rgyal mtshan 'di phul bas// ma gyur 'gro dang bdag sogs kyi// thub pa rgyal po 'od ldan du// gyur tshe byang chub mchog dam pa// smon lam thugs bskyed mdzad pa ltar// bdag gzhan kun gyis 'grub par shog /grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags shing*// sangs rgyas rnams ni bkur ba ltar// bdag kyang deng nas tshe rabs su/ /chos kyi rgyal po mchod pa dang*// 'gro kun smin cing sgrol byed shog /bdag sogs gnas pa'i yul na yang*/ /nad gdon 'khrug rtsod zhi ba dang*// ci bsam dge ba'i las rnams kyang*// 'bad pa med pa 'grub par shog |shu bhaṃ stu sarba dza ga taṃ/ zhes 'bri gung skyu ra'i gdung gi tha chung bya bral dkon mchog ming 'dzin gyis/ 'brug lo zla ba bcu gcig par bkra shis tshugs nas bris pa dge legs su gyur cig| // ༈ /'bri gung mthil du dar po cher bris pa'i smon lam ni/ kā shi ka yi dar chen ri rab mnyam pa 'di// yid bzhin bsam 'grub gling la phul ba'i mthus// thub pa'i bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa dang*// bka' brgyud bstan dang rgyal ba 'bri gung pa'i/ /bstan pa rin chen phyogs mtha' kun khyab cing*/ /'phel zhing rgyas pa'i bkra shis bstsal du gsol/ /ces rang lo bcu'i thog tu bris/// / ༈ /snyan dar 'dod gsol ni/ hrīḥ sangs rgyas stong dang rgyal ba 'bri gung ba'i// bstan pa rin chen skyong ba'i mthu rtsal can// bka' srung dbyings phyug dpal ldan lha mo'i tshogs| *||yid bzhin bsam 'grub a phyi mnyes phyir du// dri med shel sgong dar zab 'phan gdugs dang*// dam nyams bsgral phyir bshan gri sna tshogs dang*// mi rkang gling bu bstod pa'i dbyangs dang bcas// bstan srung dpal ldan lha mo'i tshogs la 'bul// phyi nang dgra bgegs ma lus zhi ba dang*// bstan pa rin chen skyong ba'i phrin las mdzod// 'brug lor kha than ba dur gyi dmag pham par byas/

bka' srung rnams la gtang rag tu spyan gzigs mang bar phul nas bstod pa'o/// / ༈ /gdan sa mthil du phag mo gru pa'i sku brnyan mthong ba don yod la snyan dar phul ba'i smon lam ni/ sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gsung thugs// gsang ba ma lus 'dzin mdzad pa// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa yi// zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal lo// de dang dbyer med 'jig rten na// 'gran pa'i zla dang bral ba'i mgon// rgyal ba gnyis pa rin chen dpal// spyi gtsug rgyan du rtag tu bzhugs// da lta rtsod dus ngan pa 'dir// dmu rgod bdag 'dra'i 'gro ba rnams// mi mngon dbyings nas brtser dgongs la/ thugs brtse dam pas bskyang du gsol// bla ma khyed kyi rdo rje'i skus// bdag lus ngan pa byin gyis rlobs// grag stong 'dzin bral tshangs dbyangs kyis| |ma dag ngag gi sgrib sbyong mdzod// 'khrul med brjod bral thugs mchog gis// gnyid 'thug mun pa sang bar mdzod// rdo rje gsum gyi byin rlabs kyis// sgo gsum sgrib pa sbyang du gsol// dbang bzhi rdzogs par bskur du gsol// rgyud bzhi yongs dag dngos grub stsol// ces 'bri gung pa dkon mchog phun tshogs kyis/ dpal kun tu bzang po'i nags khrod yang dgon gyi pho brang du bris/// / ༈ /jo bo mtsho brag pa la rgyal mtshan phul ba'i 'dod gsol ni/ rgyal kun thugs rje'i phrin las mnga' dbang phyug /gang 'dul thabs kyis ma nges skur snang ste// gdul ka 'dul phyir zhing 'dir mi min tshul// 'jig rten dbang phyug ming 'di spyi bos mchod// lta bas mi ngom sku mchog gang de 'tsher// dang po'i phyag gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar// dus gsum sangs rgyas mchod cing phrin las sgrub// g.yas kyi 'og mas shel dkar brgya rtsa bsnams// 'gro ba'i don la g.yel ba ga la zhig /g.yon gyi gnyis pas pad dkar 'dab brgyad 'chang*// skyon gyis ma gos snang brnyan ci yang snang*// ma sgrib sa ler rang rang skad dag tu// ma 'dres chos ston khyod ni bdag gis bsnyen// rin chen rgyan dang mtshan dpe'i gzi 'od 'bar// lha rdzas na bza' lhab lhub kun nas brjid// pad zla'i gdan la zhi tshul 'dzum dang bcas// gang khyod bdag gi gus pas bstod de bsnyen// yon tan brjod bral thugs rje'i bdag nyid can| |mi min lha klu ji snyed mchis pa de// blta ba'i phyir ni gus pas 'dir mchis te// gser dngul la sogs rin chen du ma dang*// bdud rtsi chos sman rnam rgyal sman gyi mchog

/dar zab ma tshang med de mchod par 'bul// lhag par sangs rgyas bstan pa rgyas pa dang*// bstan 'dzin sku tshe brtan cing dge 'dun gyi// sde 'phel 'khrug rtsod ngan pa zhi slad du// grags pa'i rgyal mtshan spyan gzigs du ma 'bul// rang rang dga' bde'i dpal la spyod par shog /rnam dkar don gnyis mthar phyin sku brnyes shog /'jig rten lo legs 'bru 'phel bde skyid shog /khyod bzhin bdag kyang 'gro ba'i dpal du shog /ces mtsho brag tu gnas la yid ches dang spro ba skyes te/ mtsho mgor gsas mkhar brtsegs par rgyal mtshan la bris pa'i smon lam mo/// / ༈ /ra sgreng gi jo bo la snyan dar phul ba'i smon tshig ni/ lha dang lha min yi dwags dud 'gro dang*// mnar med mi dang mi khom brgyad dag las// skyob mdzad 'jam dpal rdo rje'i sku brnyan la| |reg na bde ba'i lha rdzas 'di 'bul lo// gang gi thugs rje'i mthu dag dang*// bdag gi lhag bsam gang lags pa// lha mi'i bden tshig grub rnams mthus// ma lus myur du sangs rgyas shog /khyod la bdag ni rab tu gdung*// sku brnyan mtshan bzang dra ba can// bdag sogs mos ldan thams cad kyis// gegs med myur du mjal bar shog /ces rang lo bco lnga'i thog tu myur du mjal ba'i smon lam bkra shis kha btags la bris te phul ba'o/// /sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ /bsam yas su gnod sbyin chen po la bskur ba/ hūm̐ */ sngon tshe pad+ma'i bka' nyan dam tshig can// chos skyong yid bzhin nor bu mthu bo che// dregs pa yongs kyi ded dpon chen po khyod// rig 'dzin skyong dang rnal 'byor yongs la brtse// chos bzhin skyong ba chen po bdag la dgongs// khyod la lha rdzas bkra shis dar dkar dang*// nor bu shel sgong mtshon tshogs zung du 'brel// rin chen gser dang ro ldan bdud rtsis mchod// de slad 'dod mthun gdung bas khyod nyid 'bod// bdag ni sangs rgyas bstan pa 'dzin pa dang*// mos ldan gdul bya tshul bzhin skyong ba la// 'gal rkyen bar chad ma lus zhi ba dang*// mthun rkyen bsam don yar zla bzhin du sgrubs// khyad par khyod nyid dran zhing rbad tsam gyis// sngon las 'phral rkyen ngan dbang mi 'gro zhing*// nang dgra me ltar 'bar ba'i srog rtsa chod// phyi dgra rlung ltar 'tshub pa'i snying khrag 'thung*// byad dgra bsam sbyor ngan kha than ba dur pa drung nas phyung*// lha mi'i dam tshig srog gcod par khas blangs pa gnyan po de dgongs la// bdag gi bsam don ma lus 'grub par mdzod// 'di ni sog po'i rgyal po kha than ba dur zhes pas/

dpon sa gnyis ster dgos de mi ster na dmag 'dren zer bas zhe sun te chos skyong la bskur// yang bstod de gsol ba ni/ kyai/ sangs rgyas stong gi bstan pa'i bya ra mdzad// rig 'dzin dam ldan yongs kyi srung ma che// dam nyams srog gcod sde brgyad yongs kyi gtso// mthu rtsal stobs ldan khyod ni bdag gis bstod// bkra shis dar dang rin chen sa le sbram| |dam tshig zol zog med rtags shel dkar gyi// spyan gzigs mchod rten yid 'ong 'di dag dang*// ro mchog brgya ldan bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul// sngon chad khyod nyid rbad pa'i mthu nyid las// yid la gnag pa gang de rdul kha than bzhin song*// slad nas bsam sbyor ngan gshom byed pa rnams// tshar gcod snying khrag khyod kyis rngams par 'thung*// khyod nyid dran zhing bos pa tsam gyis kyang*// rtsod dus ngan las dbang du mi 'gro zhing*// rang gzhan kun gyi don byed bsgrub pa la// 'gal rkyen bar chad ma lus zhi ba dang*// mthun rkyen dbyar mtsho bzhin du ngang 'phel mdzod// 'di'ang mtha' mi rgyal bo kha than bsgral ba'i gtang rag tu/ gdan sa chen po dpal phag gru nas/ shākya'i btsun pa dkon mchog phun tshogs kyis bsam yas su chos skyong la spel/// / ༈ /zan yang du chos skyong la gnang ba/ zil gnon dbang chen khro rgyal bcom ldan 'das// sprul pa'i chos skyong gnod sbyin khro gnyer can// dus gsum sangs rgyas pad+ma'i bstan srung che// sgrub po'i dgra lha khyod la 'di skad gsol// bdag ni lan gcig min par skye gtan du// bstan dang 'gro la phan par bya ba'i phyir// bka' yi srung ma chos skyong khyod gsol na// brtse gdung ma chung zhal bzhes dam tshig dgongs// skye 'dir sngon las 'phral rkyen ngan dbang du// nam yang ma gtong khyod nyid dran tsam gyis// gdug rtsub ldan pa'i phyi nang dgra bgegs rnams// tsit+ta rak+ta rngams pa khyod nyid gsol// de slad bkra shis lha yi na bza' dang*// sa le sbram dang ro ldan bdud rtsis mchod// bdag gi bsam don gang yin khyod kyis shes// dgos pa'i don rnams yar zla bzhin du mdzod// ces pa shākya'i dge slong dkon mchog phun tshogs dpal bzang pos rang lo bcu dgu'i thog tu'o/// /maṅga laṃ//

hrīḥ dus gsum kun 'dus pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi// de yi bka' sdod gtso bo dgra lha khyod| |sngags 'chang bdag dang sngon nas dam tshig gcig /de phyir dus la bab pa dgongs par mdzod// deng sang bskal pa'i tha ma la bab pas// dam chos tshul bzhin spyod pa nyin skar tsam| |chos min sdig spyod skye bo rlung ltar 'tshub// lha khyod dam chos skyong ba nyid lags kyi// chos ldan dam tshig can la lus grib ltar// rtag tu 'grogs shing srung skyob stongs grogs mdzod// sngags 'chang bdag gi gdung bas nam bos pa// de tshe srid gsum gnas yul gar bzhugs kyang*// ma thogs myur du zhabs kyis myur gshegs la| |dam rdzas sman raka gtor ma bzhes pa dang*// bdag gi sgrub pa'i gnas mchog dam pa 'dir// rtag tu 'khor zhing bzhugs la phrin las sgrubs// sngon dus bar khang g.yu zhal du| |rdo rje slob dpon pad+ma yis// rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor zhal phye nas// sngags 'chang bdag dang dgra lha che// dam tshig gcig tu bsres pa de// thugs kyis ma brjed dgongs mdzod la| |bod khams chos 'khor gtsug lag skyongs// sngags 'chang bdag gi bsam don sgrubs// 'gal rkyen nad gdon zhi ba dang*// mthun rkyen yar ngo'i zla ltar spel// 'phral dang yun gyi bslab bya rnams// rgyun mi 'chad par bstsal du gsol// de skad zla tshes dge ba'i dus// sra brtan rdo rje'i gnas nas phul// //maṅga laṃ//
